description: This file defines the interface JsonObjectBuilder, a builder pattern for creating mutable JSON objects with various set, remove, and build methods. It offers a fluent API for setting different JSON value types conditionally, managing fields, and building the final JsonObject.

classes.name: JsonObjectBuilder
classes.description: An interface providing a fluent API for constructing mutable JSON objects with various set, remove, and build operations. It supports setting primitive types, JsonValue, and fields conditionally and in bulk, with methods to manage JSON fields by key or JsonFieldDefinition.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overloaded methods for setting JSON fields with various Java primitive types, JsonValue, or JsonField and optional predicates for conditional inclusion. Supports setting by key or JsonFieldDefinition.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a field from the JSON object by key or by JsonFieldDefinition.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields at once from an iterable of JsonFields, with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all fields from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable JsonObject containing all the fields added so far.
